q: how many orders are there
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

q: how many sellers are based in the state of SP
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP'

q: what is the average review score
gold: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews

q: how many orders are there for each order status
gold: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

q: which payment type is used most often
gold: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: what is the total payment value of credit card payments
gold: SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

q: how many orders were purchased in each year
gold: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

q: which 3 states have the most sellers
gold: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: how many orders were delivered to the customer after the estimated delivery date
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
note: literal reading; adding order_status = 'delivered' is a defensible alternative and gives a slightly different count

q: which 5 product categories, in English, have the most items sold
gold: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: what is the average review score of orders that were delivered late
gold: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date

q: which 5 customer states have the highest average freight value per order item
gold: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(i.freight_value) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: how many tracks are there
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

q: how many customers are from Brazil
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

q: which country has the most customers
gold: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: how many tracks does each genre have
gold: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name

q: which artist has the most albums
gold: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: what are the total sales per billing country
gold: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

q: what is the average track length in minutes
gold: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000 FROM Track

q: how many invoices were there in each year
gold: SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1

q: how many albums does Led Zeppelin have
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Led Zeppelin'

q: which media type is used by the most tracks
gold: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: which 5 genres generated the most sales revenue
gold: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: which 3 artists have the most tracks
gold: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: how many products are there
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products

q: how many products are discontinued
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 1

q: how many suppliers are there
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Suppliers

q: how many products are in each category
gold: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(*) FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName

q: which shipping company handled the most orders
gold: SELECT s.CompanyName, COUNT(*) FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia GROUP BY s.CompanyName ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: what is the average freight cost of an order
gold: SELECT AVG(Freight) FROM Orders

q: how many orders were placed in each year
gold: SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', OrderDate) AS INTEGER), COUNT(*) FROM Orders GROUP BY 1

q: which products have fewer units in stock than their reorder level
gold: SELECT ProductName FROM Products WHERE UnitsInStock < ReorderLevel

q: how many territories does each region have
gold: SELECT r.RegionDescription, COUNT(*) FROM Territories t JOIN Regions r ON r.RegionID = t.RegionID GROUP BY r.RegionDescription

q: what are the total sales after discounts for each product category
gold: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName

q: which 5 products generated the most revenue after discounts
gold: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.ProductName ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: which 3 countries do the most orders ship to
gold: SELECT ShipCountry, COUNT(*) FROM Orders GROUP BY ShipCountry ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
